description: This file defines a React component for displaying a list of user orders in an e-commerce application. It manages search, pagination, and conditional rendering based on loading state and data availability.

classes.name: List
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing a user's order list with search and pagination features.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component's state with an empty search string.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the user's account orders when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleOrderSearch
methods.description: Updates the search state based on user input, only if input length is >= 2.

methods.name: handleOnPagination
methods.description: Handles pagination changes by fetching orders for the selected page.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the order list UI, including search, pagination, loading indicator, and conditional messages.
